The '''SoroSuub skyhook''' was located above the the [[Planet|world]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhook]] was offered to the former members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] after they resigned their commissions from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to liberate the planet [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] from former [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]]. However, the [[New Republic Provisional Council]] issued an order to ground all [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhooks]] near the area where the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' was buried in order to provide housing for the survivors.<ref name="Bacta War" />
